::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Nov 5th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd),
I shall be very glad to see you on the 2nd and hope we shall do a great deal of business together[^2]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: CMY had written to Macmillan on September 30th: 'I believe the second part of Historical Selections is almost ready.'
